$comment: THE CANONICAL CAPTURE INDEX for lifecycle-card evidence (cinatra#2821, epic #2784 S9h).
A cell name is a CLAIM. This file is where a claim is answered by a RECORD: the host the
picture declares, the URL it was taken on, the screenshot with its SHA-256, and the anchors
that were counted on that screen, in the frame they were counted in. The rules live in
scripts/ci/lib/capture-record-contract.mjs; scripts/ci/chat-hitl-evidence-gate.mjs binds every
acceptance-manifest cell that names a host to a record here. An unindexed screenshot counts
as zero.
IT IS NO LONGER EMPTY. The first records arrive from cinatra#2855 (PR #2862): one run of the
recorder (evidence/2855-settled-outcome/drivers/capture.mjs) against a LIVE app on a lane
database, photographing gates this lane produced through the shipped producer and the app's own
review-orchestration drain. They do NOT clear the two grandfathered C1/C2 findings: those name
different cells, and adopting these pictures under those names would be exactly the mislabel
this index refuses.
ONLY chat_thread RECORDS ARE HERE, on purpose. #2862 also photographed the review page's gate
region, and that record is kept at evidence/2855-settled-outcome/capture-records.json instead:
the contract's `review_page` URL class is /^\/agents\/reviews/, while the shipped gate-region
route is /agents/<vendor>/<package>/<runId>/review/<taskId>, so a truthful page_gate_region
record cannot satisfy the class as written. That is a defect in the class, not in the picture.
A record is TEXT, and text is forgeable: a person can hand-write one with a real image and
invented counts. What the contract does catch is the accidental mislabel, the anchor nobody
measured, the drifted hash, the re-used picture, and the cell that cites nothing at all.

region; those records live at evidence/2852-before-after/capture-records.json, because the

IT IS EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Adopting the earlier S7 captures would be exactly the fabrication
this index exists to refuse: that run never looked for [data-conversation-list], so writing a
count for it would be inventing an observation nobody made. The records arrive from one run
of the recorder against a live app, which belongs to the canonical re-capture slice
(#2791, S9g). Until then the two chat cells are grandfathered findings in the rollout policy.
